name: Old Kings Market
summary: Old Kings Market is a 95,758 square foot community shopping center anchored by Stop & Shop, strategically positioned on Old Kings Highway in affluent Darien, Connecticut. The center attracts over 1.15 million annual visits, serving as a convenient neighborhood destination for daily shopping and services.
demographics: Old Kings Market serves an affluent suburban demographic in Darien, Connecticut, one of the wealthiest communities in the United States. The trade area population of approximately 69,862 within 3 miles consists primarily of high-income families and professionals with household incomes well above the national average. Shoppers are typically educated, quality-conscious consumers who value convenience and premium grocery offerings, as evidenced by the Stop & Shop anchor tenant. The daytime population of 68,628 indicates a stable residential community with strong local purchasing power and consistent shopping patterns focused on daily needs and services.
description: Old Kings Market is a well-established community shopping center strategically located at 25 Old Kings Highway South in Darien, Connecticut, just one block south of the highly traveled Boston Post Road. This 95,758 square foot center serves as a vital neighborhood hub for one of Connecticut's most affluent communities, anchored by Stop & Shop and featuring a carefully curated mix of retailers and service providers. With over 1.15 million annual visits, the center has become an integral part of daily life for Darien residents and surrounding communities. The property's prime location offers exceptional visibility and accessibility in a market characterized by high household incomes and strong consumer spending. Managed by Regency Centers, Old Kings Market exemplifies the company's commitment to developing thriving neighborhood centers that meet the everyday needs of their communities while maintaining high standards of quality and service.
